title: Shared basis library has no H orbital, so H must come from SG15_v1.0 at a matched 8 au / 100 Ry
symptom: For the B/N/O/H TZDP run (PBE adsorption energy, DZP vs TZDP), the oh-my-librpa SG15 3s3p2d orbitals cover B/N/O but the library contains no H directory, so H cannot be taken from the same source.
root_cause: The shared basis library is incomplete for H; silently omitting H or substituting an unmatched H orbital would break the PP/orbital pairing (different radial cutoff or PP family) inside the same 8 au TZDP calculation - one of the classic 'mismatched PP/orbital pair' failure modes.
minimal_fix: Take H from the local SG15_v1.0 standard library as H_gga_8au_100Ry_3s2p.orb, keeping 8 au / 100 Ry consistent with the B/N/O SG15 3s3p2d orbitals, and state the supplementary source explicitly in the results and documentation.
validation: All four elements B/N/O/H resolve to existing orbital files with the same 8 au cutoff and 100 Ry, and the PBE adsorption energy is produced for both DZP and TZDP and recorded in the documentation with the H source annotated.
avoid: Do not silently substitute an H orbital with a different cutoff or PP family, and do not assume the shared basis library is complete for every element in the system - check each element before starting.

parameters.cutoff_rule: 8 au / 100 Ry for every element in the same run
